title: pilosella cochlearis subsp. pseudauricula
intro: Pilosella cochlearis subsp. pseudauricula, commonly known as a type of leafy plant from the Asteraceae family, is a lesser-known species within the Pilosella genus. As a potential medicinal plant, the health benefits of Pilosella cochlearis subsp. pseudauricula may include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, although more research is required to confirm its effectiveness. The therapeutic actions of this plant may include modulating the immune system and reducing inflammation, although its exact mechanisms of action are not well understood. Bioactive constituents of Pilosella cochlearis subsp. pseudauricula may include sesquiterpene lactones, although further study is needed to confirm the presence and effects of these compounds.
